hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$dir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir '.agent-loop\Invoke-AgentHook.ps1') -PathType Leaf)) { $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dir; if ($parent -eq $dir) { exit 1 }; $dir = $parent }; & (Join-Path $dir '.agent-loop\Invoke-AgentHook.ps1') -Caller claude"

pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$dir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir '.claude\hooks\tastile-command-guard.ps1') -PathType Leaf)) { $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dir; if ($parent -eq $dir) { exit 0 }; $dir = $parent }; & (Join-Path $dir '.claude\hooks\tastile-command-guard.ps1')"
